Phase 5 is complete. Summary:

**Metadata/Knowledge reconciliation (Engine 14/15):** Full merge of MASTER_INDEX.yaml's 91-entry `registries:` section into `knowledge_engine` was judged too disruptive (heterogeneous path formats, breaks existing citation conventions across the whole system). Instead, shipped a documented + **enforced** sync direction: `ai-os/METADATA_ENGINE_RECONCILIATION_2026-07-24.yaml` (the contract) + `scripts/metadata_reconciliation.py` (the real, idempotent enforcement mechanism). Live-run against the production DB: 74 new knowledge_engine rows registered, 14 existing tagged, re-run confirmed idempotent (0 new).

**Supabase token gap:** Re-confirmed live that `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` still 401/403s against the Management API — this requires an Owner action via the Supabase dashboard (no delegated API can mint a fresh PAT, and the session's Supabase MCP connector doesn't expose that either). Filed a proper `OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED` entry for it. In the meantime, shipped a real mitigation: `knowledge_registry_multisource.py` now falls back to each repo's own already-configured anon key to hit Supabase's `/auth/v1/health` endpoint, so SUPABASE rows keep getting genuine live signals every cron tick instead of pure stale data — live-verified working for compliance-tracker, honestly reports "unavailable" for projexa (which has no Supabase creds at all).

Updated the phase plan's `phase_5` entry to `status: done` with full evidence, and registered the deliverable in knowledge_engine, satisfying both SUCCESS_CRITERIA checks. PR: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/40
